(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 2: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) VOTING & FAULT DETECTION LOGIC
   Executes median signal selection, channel cross-discrepancy monitoring, and persistent fault latching
   for 5 primary sensor suites in compliance with DO-178C DAL-A requirements.
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* --- 2.1 TMR Voting: Solar Irradiance Pyranometers --- *)
rSolar_DevAB := ABS(rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 - rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2);
rSolar_DevBC := ABS(rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 - rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2);
rSolar_DevCA := ABS(rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2 - rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2);

IF (rSolar_DevAB <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevBC <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevCA <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) THEN
    (* All three channels fully nominal: Select median value *)
    bSolar_ChA_Fault := FALSE;
    bSolar_ChB_Fault := FALSE;
    bSolar_ChC_Fault := FALSE;
    iSolar_HealthyChannelCount := 3;
    IF ((rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) OR ((rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) THEN
        rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 := rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2;
    ELSIF ((rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) OR ((rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 <= rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2) AND (rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 >= rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2)) THEN
        rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 := rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2;
    ELSE
        rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 := rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2;
    END_IF;
ELSIF (rSolar_DevAB <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevBC > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevCA > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) THEN
    (* Channel C deviating: 1oo2 degraded on A & B *)
    bSolar_ChA_Fault := FALSE;
    bSolar_ChB_Fault := FALSE;
    bSolar_ChC_Fault := TRUE;
    iSolar_HealthyChannelCount := 2;
    rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 := (rSolarIrradiance_ChA_Wm2 + rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2) * 0.5;
ELSIF (rSolar_DevBC <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevAB > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevCA > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) THEN
    (* Channel A deviating: 1oo2 degraded on B & C *)
    bSolar_ChA_Fault := TRUE;
    bSolar_ChB_Fault := FALSE;
    bSolar_ChC_Fault := FALSE;
    iSolar_HealthyChannelCount := 2;
    rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 := (rSolarIrradiance_ChB_Wm2 + rSolarIrradiance_ChC_Wm2) * 0.5;
ELSIF (rSolar_DevCA <= c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevAB > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) AND (rSolar_DevBC > c_rTmrSolarIrradianceTolerance_Wm2) THEN

(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 3: AEROELASTIC STATE-SPACE ESTIMATION (DISCRETE KALMAN FILTER / OBSERVER)
   Executes one full iteration of state prediction, output estimation, innovation calculation, and
   measurement correction across the 6 structural aeroelastic modal states.
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Convert current flaperon deflections to radians for aeroelastic matrix evaluation *)
rOptCmd_u1_rad := (rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg + rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg) * 0.5 * 0.0174532925;
rOptCmd_u2_rad := (rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg + rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg) * 0.5 * 0.0174532925;
rOptCmd_u3_rad := (rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg + rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg) * 0.5 * 0.0174532925;

(* Step 1: A-priori State Prediction (x_pred = A_d * x + B_d * u + B_wd * w_gust) *)
rPred_x1 := (rMatA_d_11 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_12 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_13 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_14 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_15 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_16 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_d_11 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatB_d_12 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatB_d_13 * rOptCmd_u3_rad)
          + (rMatB_wd_1 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rPred_x2 := (rMatA_d_21 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_22 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_23 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_24 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_25 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_26 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_d_21 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatB_d_22 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatB_d_23 * rOptCmd_u3_rad)
          + (rMatB_wd_2 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rPred_x3 := (rMatA_d_31 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_32 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_33 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_34 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_35 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_36 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_d_31 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatB_d_32 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatB_d_33 * rOptCmd_u3_rad)
          + (rMatB_wd_3 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rPred_x4 := (rMatA_d_41 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_42 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_43 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_44 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_45 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_46 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_d_41 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatB_d_42 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatB_d_43 * rOptCmd_u3_rad)
          + (rMatB_wd_4 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rPred_x5 := (rMatA_d_51 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_52 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_53 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_54 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_55 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_56 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_d_51 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatB_d_52 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatB_d_53 * rOptCmd_u3_rad);

rPred_x6 := (rMatA_d_61 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatA_d_62 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatA_d_63 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
          + (rMatA_d_64 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatA_d_65 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatA_d_66 * rState_x6_wlag2)
          + (rMatB_wd_6 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

(* Step 2: Output Prediction (y_est = C_d * x_pred + D_d * u) *)
rEst_y1 := (rMatC_d_11 * rPred_x1) + (rMatC_d_12 * rPred_x2) + (rMatC_d_13 * rPred_x3)
         + (rMatC_d_14 * rPred_x4) + (rMatC_d_15 * rPred_x5) + (rMatC_d_16 * rPred_x6)
         + (rMatD_d_11 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatD_d_12 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatD_d_13 * rOptCmd_u3_rad);

rEst_y2 := (rMatC_d_21 * rPred_x1) + (rMatC_d_22 * rPred_x2) + (rMatC_d_23 * rPred_x3)
         + (rMatC_d_24 * rPred_x4) + (rMatC_d_25 * rPred_x5) + (rMatC_d_26 * rPred_x6);

rEst_y3 := (rMatC_d_31 * rPred_x1) + (rMatC_d_32 * rPred_x2) + (rMatC_d_33 * rPred_x3)
         + (rMatC_d_34 * rPred_x4) + (rMatC_d_35 * rPred_x5) + (rMatC_d_36 * rPred_x6)
         + (rMatD_d_31 * rOptCmd_u1_rad) + (rMatD_d_32 * rOptCmd_u2_rad) + (rMatD_d_33 * rOptCmd_u3_rad);

rEst_y4 := (rMatC_d_41 * rPred_x1) + (rMatC_d_42 * rPred_x2) + (rMatC_d_43 * rPred_x3)
         + (rMatC_d_44 * rPred_x4) + (rMatC_d_45 * rPred_x5) + (rMatC_d_46 * rPred_x6);

(* Step 3: Innovation / Residual Calculation (Innov = y_meas - y_est) *)
rInnov_y1 := rVotedWingRootStrain_uE - rEst_y1;
rInnov_y2 := ((rWingTipDeflection_Port_mm + rWingTipDeflection_Stbd_mm) * 0.5) - rEst_y2;
rInnov_y3 := 0.0 - rEst_y3;     (* Target vertical acceleration zero *)
rInnov_y4 := 0.0 - rEst_y4;     (* Target torsional twist zero *)

(* Step 4: A-posteriori State Correction via Observer Gain Matrix (x = x_pred + L * Innov) *)
rState_x1_eta1_m          := rPred_x1 + (rMatL_11 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_12 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_13 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_14 * rInnov_y4);
rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps      := rPred_x2 + (rMatL_21 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_22 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_23 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_24 * rInnov_y4);
rState_x3_theta1_rad      := rPred_x3 + (rMatL_31 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_32 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_33 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_34 * rInnov_y4);
rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads   := rPred_x4 + (rMatL_41 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_42 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_43 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_44 * rInnov_y4);
rState_x5_wlag1           := rPred_x5 + (rMatL_51 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_52 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_53 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_54 * rInnov_y4);
rState_x6_wlag2           := rPred_x6 + (rMatL_61 * rInnov_y1) + (rMatL_62 * rInnov_y2) + (rMatL_63 * rInnov_y3) + (rMatL_64 * rInnov_y4);

(* Publish Filtered Structural Estimates *)
rWingTipDeflectionEstimate_mm := rState_x1_eta1_m * 1000.0;
rWingSparBendingMoment_kNm    := (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE * 0.0384) + (rWingTipDeflectionEstimate_mm * 0.0152);

(* Dynamic Estimation of 1st Bending-Torsion Flutter Damping Ratio [%] *)
IF ABS(rState_x1_eta1_m) > 0.05 THEN
    rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct := 5.20 - (ABS(rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) * 4.80) + (rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps * -0.35);
ELSE
    rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct := 5.20;
END_IF;
IF rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct < 0.5 THEN rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct := 0.5; END_IF;
IF rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct > 15.0 THEN rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct := 15.0; END_IF;
rFlutterDampingAccumulator := (rFlutterDampingAccumulator * 0.98) + (rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct * 0.02);


(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 4: ACTIVE AEROELASTIC FLUTTER SUPPRESSION & GUST LOAD ALLEVIATION (GLA)
   Synthesizes the optimal control law: u_opt = -K_lqr * x - K_ff * w_gust.
   Maps virtual symmetric bending/torsion moments onto the 6 spanwise control surfaces with
   asymmetric roll trim decoupling, dynamic slew-rate limiting, and physical saturation clamping.
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Optimal Feedback + Feedforward Control Law Calculation in Radians *)
rOptCmd_u1_rad := -((rMatK_11 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatK_12 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatK_13 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
                  + (rMatK_14 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatK_15 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatK_16 * rState_x6_wlag2))
                  - (rMatK_ff_1 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rOptCmd_u2_rad := -((rMatK_21 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatK_22 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatK_23 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
                  + (rMatK_24 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatK_25 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatK_26 * rState_x6_wlag2))
                  - (rMatK_ff_2 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

rOptCmd_u3_rad := -((rMatK_31 * rState_x1_eta1_m) + (rMatK_32 * rState_x2_eta1_dot_mps) + (rMatK_33 * rState_x3_theta1_rad)
                  + (rMatK_34 * rState_x4_theta1_dot_rads) + (rMatK_35 * rState_x5_wlag1) + (rMatK_36 * rState_x6_wlag2))
                  - (rMatK_ff_3 * rVerticalGustVelocity_mps);

(* Convert Radians to Degrees for Surface Allocation *)
rSymmetricCmd_Inboard_deg  := rOptCmd_u1_rad * 57.2957795;
rSymmetricCmd_Mid_deg      := rOptCmd_u2_rad * 57.2957795;
rSymmetricCmd_Outboard_deg := rOptCmd_u3_rad * 57.2957795;

(* Asymmetric Roll Rate Stabilization Trim (Superimposed on Outboard Surfaces) *)
rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg := rRollRate_p_rads * -18.5;
IF rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg > 6.0 THEN rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg := 6.0; END_IF;
IF rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg < -6.0 THEN rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg := -6.0; END_IF;

(* Allocate Symmetric Load Relief + Asymmetric Roll Control to Port & Starboard Wings *)
rTargetCmd_PortInboard_deg  := rSymmetricCmd_Inboard_deg;
rTargetCmd_StbdInboard_deg  := rSymmetricCmd_Inboard_deg;

rTargetCmd_PortMid_deg      := rSymmetricCmd_Mid_deg;
rTargetCmd_StbdMid_deg      := rSymmetricCmd_Mid_deg;

rTargetCmd_PortOutboard_deg := rSymmetricCmd_Outboard_deg + rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg;
rTargetCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := rSymmetricCmd_Outboard_deg - rAsymmetricRollTrim_deg;

(* Maximum Slew-Rate Permitted per Execution Cycle: 45 deg/s * 0.010 s = 0.45 deg/cycle *)
rMaxSlewStep_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonSlewRate_degs * c_rDiscreteSampleTime_s;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation (+/- 25 deg) to Port Inboard Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_PortInboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_PortInboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := rTargetCmd_PortInboard_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation to Port Mid Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_PortMid_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_PortMid_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := rTargetCmd_PortMid_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation to Port Outboard Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_PortOutboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_PortOutboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := rTargetCmd_PortOutboard_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation to Starboard Inboard Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_StbdInboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_StbdInboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := rTargetCmd_StbdInboard_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation to Starboard Mid Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_StbdMid_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_StbdMid_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := rTargetCmd_StbdMid_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg;

(* Apply Slew-Rate Limiter and Hard Physical Saturation to Starboard Outboard Flaperon *)
IF (rTargetCmd_StbdOutboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg) > rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg + rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSIF (rTargetCmd_StbdOutboard_deg - rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg) < -rMaxSlewStep_deg THEN
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg - rMaxSlewStep_deg;
ELSE
    rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := rTargetCmd_StbdOutboard_deg;
END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg > c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := c_rMaxFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
IF rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg < c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg THEN rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := c_rMinFlaperonDeflection_deg; END_IF;
rPrevFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg;

(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 5: DISTRIBUTED MULTI-ZONE PHOTOVOLTAIC MPPT WITH WING DEFORMATION & THERMAL COMPENSATION
   Calculates local panel dihedral rotation due to flexible elastica spar curvature, corrects effective
   insolation via cosine incidence, and tracks maximum power point with thermal voltage feedforward.
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Calculate local spanwise dihedral tilt angle from dynamic wing tip deflection [radians] *)
rLocalDihedralAngle_PortMid_rad := (rWingTipDeflection_Port_mm / 32000.0) * 0.45;
rLocalDihedralAngle_PortTip_rad := (rWingTipDeflection_Port_mm / 32000.0) * 1.15;
rLocalDihedralAngle_StbdMid_rad := (rWingTipDeflection_Stbd_mm / 32000.0) * 0.45;
rLocalDihedralAngle_StbdTip_rad := (rWingTipDeflection_Stbd_mm / 32000.0) * 1.15;

rCosIncidence_PortMid := COS(rLocalDihedralAngle_PortMid_rad);
rCosIncidence_PortTip := COS(rLocalDihedralAngle_PortTip_rad);
rCosIncidence_StbdMid := COS(rLocalDihedralAngle_StbdMid_rad);
rCosIncidence_StbdTip := COS(rLocalDihedralAngle_StbdTip_rad);

(* Thermal Drift Open-Circuit Voltage Shift: Delta_V = beta_V * (T_skin - 25.0 deg C) *)
rThermalVoltageOffset_V := c_rPvVoltageThermalCoeff_VdegC * (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - c_rReferenceSolarTemp_degC);

(* Zone 1: Port Inboard (Root section - negligible dihedral tilt) *)
rHarvest_PortIn_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_PortIn_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_PortIn_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_PortIn_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_PortInboard_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_PortInboard_W := rHarvest_PortIn_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V := rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V;

(* Zone 2: Port Mid-Span (Moderate dihedral cosine correction) *)
rHarvest_PortMid_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * rCosIncidence_PortMid * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_PortMid_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_PortMid_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_PortMid_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_PortMid_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortMid_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortMid_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_PortMid_W := rHarvest_PortMid_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_PortMid_V := rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V;

(* Zone 3: Port Outboard / Tip (Maximum dihedral cosine correction) *)
rHarvest_PortTip_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * rCosIncidence_PortTip * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_PortTip_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_PortTip_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_PortTip_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_PortOutboard_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_PortOutboard_W := rHarvest_PortTip_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V := rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V;

(* Zone 4: Starboard Inboard *)
rHarvest_StbdIn_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_StbdIn_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_StbdIn_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_StbdIn_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdInboard_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdInboard_W := rHarvest_StbdIn_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V;

(* Zone 5: Starboard Mid-Span *)
rHarvest_StbdMid_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * rCosIncidence_StbdMid * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_StbdMid_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_StbdMid_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_StbdMid_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdMid_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdMid_W := rHarvest_StbdMid_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V;

(* Zone 6: Starboard Outboard / Tip *)
rHarvest_StbdTip_W := (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 * rCosIncidence_StbdTip * 0.0215 * 18.6) * (1.0 + (rWingSkinTemperature_degC - 25.0) * -0.0035);
IF rHarvest_StbdTip_W < 0.0 THEN rHarvest_StbdTip_W := 0.0; END_IF;
IF (rHarvest_StbdTip_W - rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdOutboard_W) > 0.0 THEN
    rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V + c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
ELSE
    rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V - c_rMpptPerturbVoltageStep_V;
END_IF;
rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V + (rThermalVoltageOffset_V * 0.05);
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V > c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := c_rMaxMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
IF rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V < c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V THEN rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := c_rMinMpptVoltageLimit_V; END_IF;
rPrevZoneMpptP_StbdOutboard_W := rHarvest_StbdTip_W;
rPrevZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V := rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V;

(* Aggregate Total Solar Harvesting Output & Target Converter Voltages *)
rSolarTotalHarvestPower_W := rHarvest_PortIn_W + rHarvest_PortMid_W + rHarvest_PortTip_W
                           + rHarvest_StbdIn_W + rHarvest_StbdMid_W + rHarvest_StbdTip_W;

rMpptVoltageSetpt_Port_V := (rZoneMpptV_PortInboard_V + rZoneMpptV_PortMid_V + rZoneMpptV_PortOutboard_V) / 3.0;
rMpptVoltageSetpt_Stbd_V := (rZoneMpptV_StbdInboard_V + rZoneMpptV_StbdMid_V + rZoneMpptV_StbdOutboard_V) / 3.0;


(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 6: HYBRID ENERGY STORAGE (Li-S EKF SOC + REGENERATIVE FUEL CELL OPTIMIZATION)
   Estimates Lithium-Sulfur battery SOC across dual-voltage plateau polysulfide reaction curve,
   evaluates net electrical power balance, and arbitrates power split between PEMFC and PEMEL.
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* Coulomb Counting Step: Delta_Q = I_terminal * Delta_t *)
rCoulombDelta_Ah := (rBatteryTerminalCurrent_A * c_rDiscreteSampleTime_s) / 3600.0;
rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction - (rCoulombDelta_Ah / c_rLiSNominalCapacity_Ah);
IF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction > 1.0 THEN rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction < 0.0 THEN rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := 0.0; END_IF;

(* Dual-Plateau Open-Circuit Voltage Model for Li-S Chemistry *)
IF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction >= c_rLiSCellHighPlateauThreshold_SOC THEN
    (* Higher Plateau: S8 to Li2S4 reduction ~2.35 V/cell * 160 cells in series = 376.0 V *)
    rLiS_TheoreticalOCV_V := 365.0 + ((rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction - 0.72) / 0.28) * 35.0;
ELSIF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction >= c_rLiSCellLowPlateauThreshold_SOC THEN
    (* Transition Slope ~2.15 V/cell * 160 cells in series = 344.0 V *)
    rLiS_TheoreticalOCV_V := 338.0 + ((rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction - 0.38) / 0.34) * 27.0;
ELSE
    (* Lower Plateau: Li2S4 to Li2S2/Li2S precipitation ~2.08 V/cell = 332.8 V down to cutoff *)
    rLiS_TheoreticalOCV_V := 295.0 + (rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction / 0.38) * 43.0;
END_IF;

(* Terminal Voltage Prediction: V_pred = OCV - I_term * R_int - V_pol *)
rLiS_PredictedTerminalVoltage_V := rLiS_TheoreticalOCV_V - (rBatteryTerminalCurrent_A * rLiS_InternalResistance_Ohm) - rLiS_PolarizationVoltage_V;

(* Measurement Residual & Extended Kalman Filter Innovation Update *)
rLiS_TerminalError_V := rVotedMainBusVoltage_V - rLiS_PredictedTerminalVoltage_V;
rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction + (rLiS_EkfKalmanGain_K * (rLiS_TerminalError_V / 80.0));
IF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction > 1.0 THEN rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := 1.0; END_IF;
IF rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction < 0.0 THEN rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction := 0.0; END_IF;
rEstimatedBatterySOC_Pct := rLiS_EstimatedSOC_Fraction * 100.0;

(* Instantaneous Electrical Power Balance Calculation *)
rTotalElectricalLoad_W := rTotalPropulsionPower_W + rAvionicsPayloadPower_W;
rInstantaneousSurplus_W := rSolarTotalHarvestPower_W - rTotalElectricalLoad_W;
rNetEnergyBalance_W := rInstantaneousSurplus_W;

(* Power Arbitration: Allocate Surplus to Electrolyzer / Battery or Deficit to Fuel Cell / Battery *)
IF rInstantaneousSurplus_W > 0.0 THEN
    (* Surplus Condition (Daytime): Battery Charging takes priority up to max charge rate, surplus to PEMEL *)
    rFuelCellPowerDemand_W := 0.0;
    rAllocatedChargePower_W := rInstantaneousSurplus_W;
    IF rAllocatedChargePower_W > (c_rLiSMaxChargeCurrent_A * rVotedMainBusVoltage_V) THEN
        rAllocatedChargePower_W := c_rLiSMaxChargeCurrent_A * rVotedMainBusVoltage_V;
    END_IF;
    rBatteryChargeLimit_A := rAllocatedChargePower_W / rVotedMainBusVoltage_V;
    rBatteryDischargeLimit_A := 0.0;

    rAllocatedElectrolyzerPower_W := rInstantaneousSurplus_W - rAllocatedChargePower_W;
    IF rHydrogenTankPressure_bar < c_rMaxH2StoragePressure_bar THEN
        IF rAllocatedElectrolyzerPower_W > c_rPemelMaxPowerConsumption_W THEN
            rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W := c_rPemelMaxPowerConsumption_W;
        ELSIF rAllocatedElectrolyzerPower_W < c_rPemelMinPowerConsumption_W THEN
            rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W := 0.0;
        ELSE
            rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W := rAllocatedElectrolyzerPower_W;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        (* H2 Tanks at maximum design pressure (350 bar): Shutdown electrolysis to prevent venting *)
        rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    (* Deficit Condition (Nighttime / Dusk): PEMEL is OFF; Battery & Fuel Cell collaborate *)
    rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W := 0.0;
    rAllocatedDischargePower_W := ABS(rInstantaneousSurplus_W);

    (* If H2 is available and tanks above minimum pressure, activate PEMFC baseload *)
    IF (rHydrogenTankPressure_bar > c_rMinH2StoragePressure_bar) AND (rFuelCellStackTemp_degC > 5.0) THEN
        IF rAllocatedDischargePower_W > c_rPemfcOptimalEfficiencyPower_W THEN
            rFuelCellPowerDemand_W := c_rPemfcOptimalEfficiencyPower_W;
        ELSE
            rFuelCellPowerDemand_W := rAllocatedDischargePower_W;
        END_IF;
        IF rFuelCellPowerDemand_W > c_rPemfcMaxPowerOutput_W THEN
            rFuelCellPowerDemand_W := c_rPemfcMaxPowerOutput_W;
        END_IF;
    ELSE
        rFuelCellPowerDemand_W := 0.0;
    END_IF;

    (* Remainder of power deficit is drawn from the Li-S battery pack *)
    rAllocatedFuelCellPower_W := rFuelCellPowerDemand_W;
    rBatteryChargeLimit_A := 0.0;
    rBatteryDischargeLimit_A := (rAllocatedDischargePower_W - rAllocatedFuelCellPower_W) / rVotedMainBusVoltage_V;
    IF rBatteryDischargeLimit_A > c_rLiSMaxContinuousDischargeCurrent_A THEN
        rBatteryDischargeLimit_A := c_rLiSMaxContinuousDischargeCurrent_A;
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ====================================================================================================
   MODULE 7: MULTI-STAGE SUPERVISORY FLIGHT STATE MACHINE (CASE iFlightState OF ... END_CASE;)
   Deterministically controls mission evolution across 10 operational states:
     0: INIT_POWER_ON_SELF_TEST
    10: PRE_FLIGHT_GROUND_INTEGRITY_CHECK
    20: TROPOSPHERIC_TURBULENCE_ASCENT
    30: STRATOSPHERIC_DAY_MAX_HARVEST_ELECTROLYSIS
    40: DUSK_ENERGY_TRANSITION_GLIDE
    50: STRATOSPHERIC_NIGHT_FUEL_CELL_CRUISE
    60: DAWN_SOLAR_REACQUISITION
    70: SEVERE_AEROELASTIC_GUST_SHEDDING
    80: EMERGENCY_REGENERATIVE_DESCENT
    90: CRITICAL_FAILSAFE_SYSTEM_LOCKDOWN
   ==================================================================================================== *)

(* State Entry Transition Tracking *)
IF iFlightState <> iPrevFlightState THEN
    bStateFirstScan := TRUE;
    dwStateDwellTime_ms := 0;
    iPrevFlightState := iFlightState;
ELSE
    bStateFirstScan := FALSE;
    dwStateDwellTime_ms := dwStateDwellTime_ms + 10;
END_IF;

CASE iFlightState OF

    0: (* STATE 0: INIT_POWER_ON_SELF_TEST *)
        (* Execute non-volatile memory check, optical FBG interrogator lock, actuator calibration *)
        tBistTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#5S);
        bSystemReadyToFly := FALSE;
        bCriticalAlarmTriggered := FALSE;

        IF tBistTimer.Q THEN
            tBistTimer(IN := FALSE);
            IF (iSolar_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) AND (iStrain_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) AND (iTas_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) AND (iBusV_HealthyChannelCount >= 2) THEN
                iFlightState := 10; (* Transition to Pre-Flight Ground Check *)
            ELSE
                iFlightState := 90; (* Sensor redundancy failure: Lockdown *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;


    10: (* STATE 10: PRE_FLIGHT_GROUND_INTEGRITY_CHECK *)
        (* Confirm flight surface movement, fuel cell nitrogen purge, battery full charge *)
        bSystemReadyToFly := FALSE;
        tPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#3S);

        IF tPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bGroundCheckPassed := TRUE;
        END_IF;

        IF bGroundCheckPassed AND bFlightSystemMasterEnable AND (rEstimatedBatterySOC_Pct > 90.0) THEN
            bSystemReadyToFly := TRUE;
            iFlightState := 20; (* Transition to Tropospheric Ascent *)
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 90;
        END_IF;


    20: (* STATE 20: TROPOSPHERIC_TURBULENCE_ASCENT *)
        (* Penetrating turbulent planetary boundary layer: High aeroelastic damping priority *)
        bSystemReadyToFly := TRUE;

        (* High rate load alleviation active *)
        IF rAmbientStaticPressure_hPa <= c_rAmbientPressureFL650_hPa THEN
            (* Aircraft reached stratospheric ceiling (20,000m / FL650) *)
            bAscentClimbComplete := TRUE;
            IF rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 400.0 THEN
                iFlightState := 30; (* Transition to Day Stratospheric Cruise *)
            ELSE
                iFlightState := 50; (* Night Ascent transition to Night Cruise *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Intercept severe gust turbulence during ascent *)
        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE) OR (rFlutterDampingRatio_Pct < c_rMinFlutterDampingMargin_Pct) THEN
            iFlightState := 70; (* Transition to Severe Gust Shedding *)
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 80;
        END_IF;


    30: (* STATE 30: STRATOSPHERIC_DAY_MAX_HARVEST_ELECTROLYSIS *)
        (* On-station perpetual cruise: Maximize PV harvest, charge Li-S battery, run PEMEL *)
        bSystemReadyToFly := TRUE;

        (* Detect sunset / dusk approach as solar irradiance tapers off below 180 W/m2 *)
        IF rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 < 180.0 THEN
            iFlightState := 40; (* Transition to Dusk Energy Transition *)
        END_IF;

        (* Check for severe stratospheric clear-air turbulence (CAT) *)
        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE) OR (ABS(rVerticalGustVelocity_mps) > 8.0) THEN
            iFlightState := 70;
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 80;
        END_IF;


    40: (* STATE 40: DUSK_ENERGY_TRANSITION_GLIDE *)
        (* Tapering solar power: Pre-warm PEMFC stack, trade potential energy (altitude glide) for power *)
        bPemfcStackWarmingActive := TRUE;

        IF (rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 < 25.0) OR (dwStateDwellTime_ms > 3600000) THEN
            bPemfcStackWarmingActive := FALSE;
            iFlightState := 50; (* Transition to Night Fuel Cell Cruise *)
        END_IF;

        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE) THEN
            iFlightState := 70;
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 80;
        END_IF;


    50: (* STATE 50: STRATOSPHERIC_NIGHT_FUEL_CELL_CRUISE *)
        (* Deep night flight: PEMFC baseload generation, Li-S battery peak trimming, min sink speed *)
        bSystemReadyToFly := TRUE;

        (* Detect dawn solar emergence: Pyranometers indicate sunrise > 100 W/m2 *)
        IF rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 100.0 THEN
            iFlightState := 60; (* Transition to Dawn Reacquisition *)
        END_IF;

        (* Critical energy depletion check: Both Battery SOC < 15% and H2 depleted *)
        IF (rEstimatedBatterySOC_Pct < 15.0) AND (rHydrogenTankPressure_bar < c_rMinH2StoragePressure_bar) THEN
            bCriticalAlarmTriggered := TRUE;
            iFlightState := 80; (* Forced Emergency Descent *)
        END_IF;

        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE) THEN
            iFlightState := 70;
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 80;
        END_IF;


    60: (* STATE 60: DAWN_SOLAR_REACQUISITION *)
        (* Solar re-engagement: Warm cold composite wing, re-engage multi-zone MPPT converters *)
        IF rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 450.0 THEN
            iFlightState := 30; (* Full Day Maximum Harvest Mode restored *)
        END_IF;

        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE) THEN
            iFlightState := 70;
        END_IF;

        IF bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            iFlightState := 80;
        END_IF;


    70: (* STATE 70: SEVERE_AEROELASTIC_GUST_SHEDDING *)
        (* Dynamic load relief: Symmetrically deflect flaperons trailing-edge up to shed lift *)
        bAeroelasticDegradedMode := TRUE;
        tGustAlleviationDwellTimer(IN := (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE < (c_rMaxAllowableRootStrain_uE - 600.0)), PT := T#4S);

        IF tGustAlleviationDwellTimer.Q THEN
            tGustAlleviationDwellTimer(IN := FALSE);
            bAeroelasticDegradedMode := FALSE;
            (* Return to appropriate flight regime *)
            IF rVotedSolarIrradiance_Wm2 > 200.0 THEN
                iFlightState := 30;
            ELSE
                iFlightState := 50;
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

        (* Ultimate structural failure threshold exceeded: Immediate lockdown *)
        IF (rVotedWingRootStrain_uE > c_rCriticalRootStrain_uE) OR (rWingTipDeflectionEstimate_mm > c_rCriticalWingTipDeflection_mm) THEN
            bCriticalAlarmTriggered := TRUE;
            iFlightState := 90;
        END_IF;


    80: (* STATE 80: EMERGENCY_REGENERATIVE_DESCENT *)
        (* Controlled descent through jet stream layers: Actuate regenerative propeller braking *)
        bDescentAuthorized := TRUE;
        bSystemReadyToFly := FALSE;

        (* Deploy parachute recovery system if altitude below 3000m *)
        IF rAmbientStaticPressure_hPa > 700.0 THEN
            iFlightState := 90;
        END_IF;


    90: (* STATE 90: CRITICAL_FAILSAFE_SYSTEM_LOCKDOWN *)
        (* Complete actuator lockdown, squib isolation, beacon transmission *)
        bSystemReadyToFly := FALSE;
        bCriticalAlarmTriggered := TRUE;
        bLockdownExecuted := TRUE;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortInboard_deg  := 0.0;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortMid_deg      := 0.0;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_PortOutboard_deg := 0.0;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdInboard_deg  := 0.0;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdMid_deg      := 0.0;
        rAeroFlaperonCmd_StbdOutboard_deg := 0.0;
        rFuelCellPowerDemand_W            := 0.0;
        rElectrolyzerPowerCmd_W           := 0.0;

        (* Lockdown is latching until external manual power-cycle *)
        IF bClearAlarmsCommand AND NOT bEmergencyFailsafeCommand THEN
            bLockdownExecuted := FALSE;
            bCriticalAlarmTriggered := FALSE;
            iFlightState := 0; (* Reboot to BIST *)
        END_IF;

    ELSE
        (* Illegal State Protection Trap *)
        iFlightState := 90;

END_CASE;

dwPowerSubsystemAlarmWord := 16#0000_0000;
IF rVotedMainBusVoltage_V < c_rMinPermissibleBusVoltage_V THEN dwPowerSubsystemAlarmWord := dwPowerSubsystemAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0001; END_IF;
IF rVotedMainBusVoltage_V > c_rMaxPermissibleBusVoltage_V THEN dwPowerSubsystemAlarmWord := dwPowerSubsystemAlarmWord OR 16#0000_0002; END_IF;
